$comment: Injuries from fist fights (D-070, data/society/fights.json). You know you've been hit, so they're diagnosed the moment they happen; treatment at the clinic or the ER ends them early, otherwise they heal on their own. Kind 'injury'.

conditions.name: Bruises
conditions.onset: You're bruised. It'll ache for a day or two.

conditions.name: A black eye
conditions.onset: Your eye is swelling shut. Everyone is going to ask.

conditions.name: A cracked rib
conditions.onset: Every breath hurts: a cracked rib. A clinic can strap it up.
